_label: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLES written for the TINGLE prototype. No real people, companies, messages or links. 'extraction' is a hand-written stand-in for what a model would return, so these run without an API key.

cases.title: Urgent internship registration fee with a short link
cases.text: Congratulations! You are selected for a Data Analyst internship at BrightPath Talent. To reserve your seat, pay a registration fee of ₹699 within 10 minutes. Pay here: https://bit.ly/synthetic-demo-offer

extraction.message_summary: An internship offer asks for a registration fee within 10 minutes.
uncertainties: The sender's identity has not been verified

cases.title: Caller-style message asking to read out a code
cases.text: Hello, this is SafeBank support. Your account is under review. Please read out the 6-digit code we just sent to your phone so we can verify you.

extraction.message_summary: A message claiming to be bank support asks for a code sent to the reader's phone.

requested_action.evidence_quote: read out the 6-digit code we just sent to your phone

signals.evidence_quote: read out the 6-digit code we just sent to your phone

cases.title: Helpdesk message asking to install remote-access software
cases.text: IT Helpdesk: Your laptop has a problem. Install the RemoteFix app so our technician can control your screen and repair it.

extraction.message_summary: A helpdesk message asks the reader to install an app that lets a technician control the screen.

requested_action.evidence_quote: Install the RemoteFix app so our technician can control your screen

uncertainties: RemoteFix is a made-up app name for this example

cases.title: Parcel message asking to click a short link
cases.text: Your parcel is on hold. Confirm delivery details here: https://tinyurl.com/synthetic-demo-parcel

extraction.message_summary: A parcel message asks the reader to open a shortened link.
uncertainties: No sender or courier is named

cases.title: Campus event reminder with a deadline
cases.text: Reminder: Registration for the Science Club quiz closes on Friday at 5 PM. Sign up on the notice board or ask your class representative.

extraction.message_summary: A club reminder says quiz registration closes on Friday.

cases.title: Security notice that says NOT to share an OTP
cases.text: SafeBank alert: We will never ask you for your OTP. Never share your OTP with anyone, even if they say they are from the bank.

extraction.message_summary: A bank notice warns the reader never to share their OTP.

signals.evidence_quote: Never share your OTP with anyone

cases.title: Ordinary link with no request
cases.text: FYI, the workshop slides from yesterday are here: https://slides.example.test/workshop-notes

extraction.message_summary: A message shares a link to workshop slides.

cases.title: Fest ticket payment at a desk, no pressure
cases.text: Cultural fest tickets are ₹200. You can pay at the student desk in the main block during lunch hours.

extraction.message_summary: A message says fest tickets can be paid for at a student desk.

cases.title: Real-looking exam fee reminder (known false-alarm case)
cases.note: Known limitation: the rules cannot tell a genuine fee from a fraudulent one. A payment request plus a deadline gives PAUSE & VERIFY, which only means 'check it with the official office'.
cases.text: Last date to pay the semester exam fee at the college office is 15 November. Please pay before the deadline.

extraction.message_summary: A reminder says the semester exam fee must be paid at the college office by 15 November.

requested_action.evidence_quote: pay the semester exam fee at the college office
